degrade.removeBulletStartingWith: - **Write the failing test before the change.**

repeated.degradedPassesWhen: at least k of its runsPerSide runs fail
repeated.realPassesWhen: at most k of its runsPerSide runs fail

lowCap.expect: exit 1, prints spent and cap, 0 passed; the cap is below the cheapest eval measured in this gate run

also: the contract file hashes the same as its state at the branch cut (merge-base of HEAD and baseRef) before and after the runs
the measured cost of every run in the gate is summed and is under the per-suite cap in budget
every run is recorded; no run is repeated to improve a result
